title: Apr-Jun 2026: Schemes, Reports, Culture, Sports & Awards

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Telangana's decision on cancer in April 2026:
1. Telangana declared cancer a notifiable disease, requiring government and private hospitals, diagnostic labs and clinics to report diagnosed cases within one month through a state portal.
2. The Mehdi Nawaz Jung Institute of Oncology, the designated Centre of Excellence, is located in Warangal.
3. A notifiable disease must be reported to the public health authorities by law so that it can be put under surveillance.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Mehdi Nawaz Jung Institute of Oncology and Regional Cancer Centre is in Hyderabad and coordinates with the National Cancer Registry. Public health is a State subject, which is why a State order can make a disease notifiable.
questions.s: Drishti IAS and All India Radio, 8 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Census 2027:
1. It is the 16th census in the series and the 8th since independence.
2. It is India's first fully digital census, using a mobile enumeration app and a self-enumeration portal in 16 languages.
3. The data are collected under the Census Act, 1951.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Census data are collected under the Census Act, 1948. The houselisting phase launched by the Ministry of Home Affairs in April 2026 offered an online self-enumeration facility for the first time in India; population enumeration, including caste, follows in February 2027.
questions.s: PIB, All India Radio and Deccan Herald, Apr-May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about schemes in the news in April 2026:
1. The Namo Drone Didi Yojana provides drones for agricultural services to women-led self-help groups.
2. The PM Vishwakarma scheme was launched on 2 October 2023 for 18 traditional trades.
3. The Vibrant Villages Programme is a Ministry of Home Affairs scheme for border villages in States and Union Territories such as Arunachal Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Sikkim and Ladakh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PM Vishwakarma was launched on 17 September 2023, the birth anniversary of Vishwakarma, and was reported in April 2026 to have over 30 lakh registrations. Skilling under the Vibrant Villages Programme is routed through the Skill India Digital Hub.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi and IAS Baba, Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Civil Services Day:
1. It is observed on 21 April each year; the 18th such Day was observed at Vigyan Bhawan in 2026.
2. It marks Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's 1947 address to the first batch of administrative service probationers at Metcalfe House.
3. The Prime Minister's Awards for Excellence in Public Administration are conferred by the Union Public Service Commission.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Awards are conferred by the Prime Minister on Civil Services Day, and are administered by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances, not the UPSC. The PM Vishwakarma scheme won the award for 2024 and was highlighted at the 2026 event.
questions.s: IAS Baba, 21 Apr 2026

questions.q: National Maritime Day, observed on 5 April 2026 with the theme 'Maritime India - Empowering Progress', commemorates which event?
o: The launch of the Sagarmala programme in March 2015
The maiden voyage of the S.S. Loyalty from Mumbai to London on 5 April 1919
The commissioning of INS Vikrant as India's first aircraft carrier
The first voyage of an Indian naval ship around the Cape of Good Hope in 1947
questions.e: The day commemorates the maiden voyage of the S.S. Loyalty from Mumbai to London on 5 April 1919. Sagarmala, launched in March 2015, is a ports-led development programme, not the event commemorated.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 5 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Mission for Cotton Productivity approved by the Union Cabinet in May 2026:
1. It has an outlay of Rs 5,659 crore for the five years 2026-27 to 2030-31.
2. It targets raising cotton yields from about 440 kg per hectare towards 755 kg per hectare.
3. It is expected to benefit roughly 3.2 crore farmers.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Mission is expected to benefit roughly 32 lakh farmers, a tenth of the number in statement 3. Raising productivity matters because India has the world's largest cotton area but average yields well below those of leading producers.
questions.s: Drishti IAS and Tribune, May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the NCRB's Prison Statistics India 2024 report, released in May 2026:
1. National prison occupancy stood at 112.7 per cent at the end of 2024.
2. Delhi had the highest occupancy among States and UTs at 194.6 per cent, followed by Meghalaya.
3. Undertrial prisoners formed about 73 per cent of all inmates.
4. Prisons are a Union List subject under the Seventh Schedule.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 to 3 are correct. Prisons are a State List subject (Entry 4 of List II), which is why prison reform depends heavily on State governments. Section 479 of the BNSS (earlier Section 436A of the CrPC) allows release of eligible undertrials after serving a fixed fraction of the maximum sentence, a key remedy for overcrowding.
questions.s: Daily Excelsior and Drishti IAS, May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the social security schemes launched in 2015 that completed 11 years in May 2026:
1. The Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana and Atal Pension Yojana were all launched in 2015.
2. The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana gives Rs 2 lakh life cover for Rs 436 a year.
3. The Atal Pension Yojana is administered by the PFRDA and guarantees a pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 a month after age 60.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Rs 436 a year buys the Rs 2 lakh life cover of PMJJBY (ages 18-50); PMSBY gives Rs 2 lakh accident cover for Rs 20 a year (ages 18-70). APY is open to those aged 18 to 40. Cumulative enrolments across the three schemes were about 94.5 crore.
questions.s: Drishti IAS and IANS, 9 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the NITI Aayog report 'School Education System in India: Temporal Analysis and Policy Roadmap for Quality Enhancement', released in May 2026:
1. It has 13 recommendations, of which 8 are systemic and 5 are academic.
2. It draws mainly on the Annual Status of Education Report (ASER) data.
3. It analyses a decade of data, from 2014-15 to 2024-25, on access, enrolment, infrastructure, equity and learning outcomes.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The report draws on UDISE+ and National Achievement Survey (NAS) data, which are government datasets, whereas ASER is produced by the non-governmental Pratham. It also lays out 33 implementation pathways and over 125 measurable Performance Success Indicators.
questions.s: All India Radio and Vision IAS, 7 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the SIPRI Yearbook 2026:
1. It estimates India's nuclear arsenal at 190 warheads as of January 2026, ahead of Pakistan's 170 and behind China's 620.
2. SIPRI is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
3. It records that the New START treaty between the US and Russia was extended in February 2026 until 2031.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The New START treaty expired in February 2026 rather than being extended, which SIPRI noted. SIPRI also noted that India had for the first time placed a portion of its warheads in a deployed state; 12 of the 190 are deployed.
questions.s: Drishti IAS and India TV, Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the release of the 23rd instalment of PM-KISAN on 20 June 2026:
1. The Prime Minister released it from Tarakeswar in Hooghly district of West Bengal, transferring about Rs 18,880 crore to more than 9.44 crore farmers.
2. PM-KISAN provides Rs 6,000 a year in two instalments of Rs 3,000.
3. PM-KISAN was launched in 2019 and is a Central Sector scheme.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PM-KISAN pays Rs 6,000 a year in three instalments of Rs 2,000 by Direct Benefit Transfer to eligible farmer families. It was launched on 24 February 2019 and its nodal ministry is Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; being Central Sector, the Centre bears the entire cost.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, Outlook Money and PIB, 20 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana in June 2026:
1. The annual cap on subsidised LPG refills was cut from nine cylinders to four per household through a formal Cabinet decision.
2. The Government said that about 86.6 per cent of Ujjwala households now use LPG as their primary fuel.
3. The scheme was launched in 2016 to give LPG connections to women from poor households.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Centre was reported on 8-9 June to have made the cut without a formal announcement, amid costlier LPG during the West Asia crisis. The Government defended the cut by pointing to the high share of households using LPG as the primary fuel.
questions.s: Business Today, ThePrint and The Wire, 8-9 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Statement-I: World Environment Day 2026 was hosted by Azerbaijan, with global celebrations in Baku.
Statement-II: World Environment Day is led by the United Nations Environment Programme and is hosted by a different country each year.
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both statements are correct, but Statement-II describes the general arrangement; it does not explain why Azerbaijan was chosen. The 2026 theme was 'Inspired by Nature. For Climate. For Our Future'. The Day was established after the 1972 UN Conference on the Human Environment in Stockholm and first celebrated in 1973 under the slogan 'Only One Earth'.
questions.s: World Environment Day and Drishti IAS, 5 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Raja Ravi Varma's 'Yashoda and Krishna', sold in April 2026:
1. It sold for Rs 167.20 crore at Saffronart's Spring Live Auction in Mumbai on 1 April 2026, a record for an Indian artwork at auction.
2. The earlier record was set by Amrita Sher-Gil's 'The Story Teller'.
3. Ravi Varma pioneered oil painting and the lithographic reproduction of Hindu mythological themes in India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The previous record was M.F. Husain's 'Untitled (Gram Yatra)', sold at Christie's in March 2025 for over Rs 118 crore. Ravi Varma, born in 1848 at Kilimanoor in Kerala, made mythological images widely available through his Ravi Varma Press.
questions.s: Business Today and ETV Bharat, 1 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the FIDE Candidates Tournaments 2026:
1. Uzbekistan's Javokhir Sindarov won the Open section and earned the right to challenge India's D. Gukesh for the World Chess Championship.
2. R. Vaishali won the Women's section and will challenge China's Ju Wenjun for the Women's World Championship.
3. The tournaments were held in Chennai, India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Both Candidates were played together at Pegeia, Cyprus, from 28 March to 16 April 2026. Sindarov finished on 10/14 and Vaishali scored 8.5/14 after beating Russia's Kateryna Lagno in the final round; the title match is scheduled for Geneva.
questions.s: Wikipedia, IANS and All India Radio, 14-15 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about two figures remembered in April 2026:
1. Jyotirao Phule opened a girls' school at Bhide Wada in Pune in 1848 with his wife Savitribai.
2. Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873 and wrote Gulamgiri in the same year.
3. Adi Shankaracharya established the Jyotir Math in Odisha and the Govardhan Math in Uttarakhand.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The two northern and eastern mathas are swapped in statement 3: Jyotir Math is in Uttarakhand and Govardhan Math is in Odisha. The other two are Sringeri (Karnataka) and Dwarka (Gujarat). Phule's 200th birth anniversary celebrations began on 11 April 2026.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi and IAS Baba, 11-21 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the International Booker Prize 2026:
1. Taiwan Travelogue by Yang Shuang-zi, translated by Lin King, won the prize.
2. The prize money of GBP 50,000 goes entirely to the author.
3. The 2025 winner was Banu Mushtaq's Heart Lamp, published by the same English-language publisher, And Other Stories.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The International Booker prize money is split equally between author and translator, which is why translators are honoured by name. The prize was announced at Tate Modern in London on 19 May 2026, and the jury was chaired by Natasha Brown.
questions.s: Scroll and The Bookseller, 19 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about sporting finals in May 2026:
1. Royal Challengers Bengaluru beat Gujarat Titans by five wickets in the IPL 2026 final at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad, becoming back-to-back champions.
2. Paris Saint-Germain retained the UEFA Champions League by beating Arsenal 4-3 on penalties after a 1-1 draw in the final at Budapest.
3. Royal Challengers Bengaluru had won their first IPL title in 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: RCB won their first IPL title in 2025, so 2026 made them back-to-back champions. PSG's win, after a first title in 2025, was also back-to-back, with Vitinha named player of the match.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, The News Minute and ESPN, 30-31 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about cultural events in May 2026:
1. Cristian Mungiu's film Fjord won the Palme d'Or at the 79th Cannes Film Festival, his second Palme.
2. Park Chan-wook, the first Korean to hold the post, was the jury president at Cannes.
3. The Eurovision Song Contest 2026, held in Vienna, was won by Israel.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Bulgaria's Dara won Eurovision 2026 with 'Bangaranga', Bulgaria's first win, while Israel finished second. The contest was hosted by Austria, which had won the 2025 contest through JJ.
questions.s: Celluloid Junkie, The Wrap and BTA, 16-23 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Anaimangalam (Leiden) copper plates:
1. The Netherlands handed them back to India during Prime Minister Modi's visit in May 2026.
2. The plates record grants to a Hindu temple at Thanjavur.
3. The plates are bound by a bronze ring bearing the Chola royal seal.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The 11th-century Chola-era plates record grants to the Chudamani Vihara, a Buddhist monastery at Nagapattinam, showing the Cholas' patronage of Buddhism. The 21 plates weigh about 30 kg, and India and the Netherlands also elevated ties to a Strategic Partnership during the visit.
questions.s: Business Today and ETV Bharat, 16 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Padma Awards 2026:
1. At the first Civil Investiture Ceremony on 25 May 2026 the President presented 66 awards, out of 131 approved for the year.
2. The Padma Vibhushan recipients at that ceremony were the late actor Dharmendra, conferred posthumously, and violin maestro N. Rajam.
3. The Padma Awards are announced on the eve of Independence Day.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Padma Awards are announced on the eve of Republic Day, not Independence Day, and are conferred by the President. The first ceremony had 2 Padma Vibhushan, 6 Padma Bhushan and 58 Padma Shri; Dharmendra's award was received by Hema Malini.
questions.s: ETV Bharat and All India Radio, 25 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the French Open 2026:
1. Russia's Mirra Andreeva won the women's singles title, beating Poland's qualifier Maja Chwalinska 6-3, 6-2.
2. Germany's Alexander Zverev beat Spain's Carlos Alcaraz in the men's singles final.
3. The French Open is played on clay at Roland Garros, Paris.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Zverev won his first Grand Slam singles title by beating Italy's Flavio Cobolli 6-1, 4-6, 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-1. Andreeva, 19, won her first Grand Slam; Chwalinska was ranked 114th, the lowest-ranked women's finalist since rankings began in 1975.
questions.s: Euronews, Irish Times and DT Next, 6-7 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 2026 FIFA World Cup:
1. It is the first World Cup with 48 teams and the first hosted by three countries: the United States, Mexico and Canada.
2. It opened on 11 June 2026 with a match between the co-hosts the United States and Canada.
3. The final is scheduled for 19 July at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The opener was Mexico against South Africa at the Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, which Mexico won 2-0. The tournament has 104 matches over 39 days.
questions.s: Newsfirst and Tico Times, 11 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the International Day of Yoga 2026:
1. The theme was 'Yoga for Healthy Ageing', and the Prime Minister led the main event at Red Road, Kolkata.
2. The UN General Assembly declared 21 June as International Day of Yoga in 2016.
3. India set a Guinness World Record with a nationwide live yoga session with over 4 lakh participants on 14 June 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The UN General Assembly adopted India's proposal in December 2014, following Modi's 2014 address, and the first Day was observed on 21 June 2015. The Ministry of Ayush is the nodal ministry, and the 2026 Day was the 12th.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, All India Radio and PIB, 14-21 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the second Civil Investiture Ceremony for the Padma Awards 2026, held on 23 June 2026:
1. The President conferred 65 awards, with Padma Vibhushan going to K.T. Thomas and P. Narayanan.
2. In all, 131 Padma awards were approved for 2026: 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri.
3. Cricketer Rohit Sharma received a Padma Bhushan at the ceremony.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Rohit Sharma was among the Padma Shri awardees, as were hockey player Savita Punia and actor R. Madhavan. Padma Bhushan recipients included Mammootty, Alka Yagnik, Vijay Amritraj and Vellappally Natesan.
questions.s: All India Radio and Manorama Yearbook, 23 Jun 2026
